items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: Then I played with Henry Russ.

ctx.x: You see? Wiling around Pittsburgh, Baltimore, New York, Philadelphia around there, you know. Then I came back home here. When I came back, the first one I played with when I came back here, I think, was Kid Howard. I started playing with him. Then I played with Henry Russ. I played with Henry Horton's band. Then I left and I went on the road again. Yeah.
